title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of the TiZrNbMoTa refractory high-entropy alloy produced by mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying of Ti, Nb, Mo, Ta and ZrH₂ powders for 30 hours using carbide balls under argon atmosphere, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1300-1600°C for 30 minutes under 50 MPa pressure in vacuum
